title: App crashes on startup when the config file is missing
body:
Steps to reproduce: install the tool and run it in a folder with no config file.

Expected: a friendly error message.
Actual: it crashes with a traceback and exit code 1.

Version 0.1.0 on Windows 11.

title: Add a dark mode option for the report page
body: Please add a dark mode option for the report page. It would help when reviewing triage reports at night. A simple toggle in the header would be enough.
